description: Header file defining the AlpsDecoder class for parsing HTTP/2 frames in the ALPS TLS extension, including nested classes for settings and ACCEPT_CH frame parsing.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding HTTP/2 frames in the ALPS TLS extension, managing settings and ACCEPT_CH frame parsing.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder::SettingsParser
classes.description: Nested class implementing a visitor for parsing HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames.

classes.name: AlpsDecoder::AcceptChParser
classes.description: Nested class implementing a visitor for parsing ACCEPT_CH frames.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a stream of HTTP/2 frames received via the ALPS TLS extension, returning an error status.

methods.name: settings_frame_count
methods.description: Returns the number of SETTINGS frames received.
